facts.fact: An EU-funded EUR 23m agreement signed by the European Commission, ESTDEV and HAUS provides for ESTDEV to create a data exchange framework and layer based on Estonia's X-Road in Nigeria, with NITDA, NIMC, NDPC, Galaxy Backbone and FMCIDE collaborating over about three years.
